summary: Wired goal.semgrep mode into agent executor build-gate flow: added semgrepMode resolution (default step), restricted between-step SAST injection to semgrepMode=step, and added final-gate SAST injection only for semgrepMode=goal. Added agent-executor tests with a build-gate partial mock to assert buildDefaultSastCommand call behavior and command ordering for off/step/goal modes. Verified with pnpm vitest run src/goal/agent-executor.test.ts, pnpm build, and pnpm lint.
